# Earth-Economy Mapping

Create sankey plot that is interactive. Show ecosystem categories. These map into NAICS codes. Then map into emissions.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| cache: true

# Ensure necessary pacakages
required_pkgs <- c("readxl", "dplyr", "tidyr", "stringr", "plotly")
missing_pkgs <- required_pkgs[!vapply(required_pkgs, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
	stop("Install required packages first: ", paste(missing_pkgs, collapse = ", "))
}

# Library
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(plotly)

# Set WD 
setwd("E:/matrix/")

# Pull code labels from Quarto headers so Sankey hover text includes meanings.
extract_code_labels <- function(path, code_prefix = c("SEEA", "EM")) {
	code_prefix <- match.arg(code_prefix)
	if (!file.exists(path)) {
		return(tibble(code = character(), label = character()))
	}

	lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
	pattern <- if (code_prefix == "SEEA") {
		"^\\s*#{1,6}\\s*(.*?)\\s*\\((SEEA\\s+(?:CF|[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+))\\)"
	} else {
		"^\\s*#{1,6}\\s*(.*?)\\s*\\((EM\\s+[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+)\\)"
	}

	m <- stringr::str_match(lines, pattern)
	out <- tibble(
		label = stringr::str_squish(m[, 2]),
		code = stringr::str_squish(m[, 3])
	) |>
		filter(!is.na(code), code != "") |>
		distinct(code, .keep_all = TRUE)

	out
}

seea_labels <- extract_code_labels("./thematrix/methods/ecosystem_services.qmd", "SEEA")
em_labels <- extract_code_labels("./thematrix/methods/emissions.qmd", "EM")

seea_lookup <- setNames(seea_labels$label, seea_labels$code)
em_lookup <- setNames(em_labels$label, em_labels$code)

# Read data 
raw_map <- read_excel("./thematrix/assets/naics_mapping_ai.xlsx")

# Column positions are fixed in the generated workbook.
map_df <- tibble(
	naics_code = as.character(raw_map[[2]]),
	naics_title = as.character(raw_map[[3]]),
	prov = as.character(raw_map[[4]]),
	reg = as.character(raw_map[[5]]),
	nonmat = as.character(raw_map[[6]]),
	s1 = as.character(raw_map[[7]]),
	s2 = as.character(raw_map[[8]]),
	s3 = as.character(raw_map[[9]])
    ) |>
	mutate(
		naics_code = str_trim(naics_code),
		naics_title = str_squish(naics_title),
		naics_node = if_else(
			is.na(naics_code) | naics_code == "",
			naics_title,
			paste0(naics_code, " - ", naics_title)
		)
	)

# For simplicity, keep only 3 digit 
# map_df <- map_df[nchar(map_df$naics_code) == 3, ]
map_df <- map_df[nchar(map_df$naics_code) == 2, ]

# Shift to Long Format
services_long <- map_df |>
	pivot_longer(
		cols = c(prov, reg, nonmat),
		names_to = "service_bucket",
		values_to = "service_codes"
	) |>
	filter(!is.na(service_codes), service_codes != "") |>
	separate_rows(service_codes, sep = ";\\s*") |>
	mutate(
		service_codes = str_trim(service_codes),
		service_label = dplyr::coalesce(unname(seea_lookup[service_codes]), service_codes),
		service_bucket = recode(
			service_bucket,
			prov = "Provisioning",
			reg = "Regulating",
			nonmat = "Non-material"
		),
		service_node = paste0(service_bucket, ": ", service_codes, " - ", service_label)
	) |>
	filter(service_codes != "")

emissions_long <- map_df |>
	pivot_longer(
		cols = c(s1, s2, s3),
		names_to = "scope_bucket",
		values_to = "emission_codes"
	) |>
	filter(!is.na(emission_codes), emission_codes != "") |>
	separate_rows(emission_codes, sep = ";\\s*") |>
	mutate(
		emission_codes = str_trim(emission_codes),
		emission_label = dplyr::coalesce(unname(em_lookup[emission_codes]), emission_codes),
		scope_bucket = recode(
			scope_bucket,
			s1 = "Scope 1",
			s2 = "Scope 2",
			s3 = "Scope 3"
		),
		emission_node = paste0(scope_bucket, ": ", emission_codes, " - ", emission_label)
	) |>
	filter(emission_codes != "")

# Link Across Groups
links_services_naics <- services_long |>
	distinct(service_node, naics_node) |>
	count(service_node, naics_node, name = "value") |>
	transmute(source = service_node, target = naics_node, value, link_group = "Service -> NAICS")

links_naics_emissions <- emissions_long |>
	distinct(naics_node, emission_node) |>
	count(naics_node, emission_node, name = "value") |>
	transmute(source = naics_node, target = emission_node, value, link_group = "NAICS -> Emission")

links_all <- bind_rows(links_services_naics, links_naics_emissions)

# Create Major Nodes
nodes <- tibble(name = unique(c(links_all$source, links_all$target))) |>
	mutate(
		node_group = case_when(
			str_detect(name, "^(Provisioning|Regulating|Non-material):") ~ "Service",
			str_detect(name, "^Scope [123]:") ~ "Emission",
			TRUE ~ "NAICS"
		),
		node_color = case_when(
			str_detect(name, "^Provisioning:") ~ "rgba(9, 103, 18, 0.88)",
			str_detect(name, "^Regulating:") ~ "rgba(19, 160, 179, 0.88)",
			str_detect(name, "^Non-material:") ~ "rgba(151, 60, 225, 0.88)",
			node_group == "NAICS" ~ "rgba(8, 8, 8, 0.85)",
			str_detect(name, "^Scope 1:") ~ "rgba(154, 21, 21, 0.88)",
			str_detect(name, "^Scope 2:") ~ "rgba(209, 155, 31, 0.88)",
			str_detect(name, "^Scope 3:") ~ "rgba(235, 205, 53, 0.88)",
			TRUE ~ "rgba(120, 120, 120, 0.85)"
		),
		hover_label = name,
		display_label = ""
	) |>
	group_by(node_group) |>
	arrange(name, .by_group = TRUE) |>
	mutate(
		node_x = case_when(
			node_group == "Service" ~ 0.02,
			node_group == "NAICS" ~ 0.50,
			TRUE ~ 0.98
		),
		node_y = if (dplyr::n() == 1) 0.5 else (row_number() - 1) / (dplyr::n() - 1)
	) |>
	ungroup()

# Create Linkage
links_idx <- links_all |>
	transmute(
		source = match(source, nodes$name) - 1,
		target = match(target, nodes$name) - 1,
		value = value,
		link_group = link_group,
		hover_label = paste0(source, " -> ", target),
		link_color = case_when(
			link_group == "Service -> NAICS" ~ "rgba(123, 198, 126, 0.45)",
			TRUE ~ "rgba(216, 138, 111, 0.45)"
		)
	)

# Dynamic height so the full sankey remains visible in Quarto render.
max_nodes_in_column <- max(as.integer(table(nodes$node_group)))
plot_height <- max(900, 32 * max_nodes_in_column)

# Sankey Plot
plot_ly(
	type = "sankey",
	arrangement = "snap",
	node = list(
		label = nodes$display_label,
		x = nodes$node_x,
		y = nodes$node_y,
		customdata = nodes$hover_label,
		color = nodes$node_color,
		pad = 18,
		thickness = 18,
		line = list(color = "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18)", width = 0.5),
		hovertemplate = "%{customdata}<extra></extra>"
	),
	link = list(
		source = links_idx$source,
		target = links_idx$target,
		value = links_idx$value,
		color = links_idx$link_color,
		customdata = links_idx$hover_label,
		hovertemplate = "%{customdata}<br>Mapped links: %{value}<extra></extra>"
	)
) |>
	layout(
		height = plot_height,
		autosize = TRUE,
		font = list(size = 11),
		margin = list(l = 20, r = 20, t = 10, b = 10)
	)

```


# Heuristics-Based Mapping


We implement a deterministic Python rule to map ecosystem service inputs into NAICS codes and then NAICS codes into emission byproducts. The output of this product can be foudn in: [naics_mapping.xlsx](assets/naics_mapping_ai.xlsx).

The heuristic workflow is:

1. Read the NAICS sheet with 2022 NAICS codes and titles.
2. Build ecosystem-service code candidates from the Quarto taxonomy in [Ecosystem Services](methods/ecosystem_services.qmd):
* Provisioning mapped as SEEA 1.x and SEEA CF
* Regulating mapped as SEEA 2.x,
* And non-material mapped as SEEA 3.x and SEEA 4.1.
3. Build emissions code candidates from the Quarto taxonomy in [Emissions](methods/emissions.qmd):
* Scope 1 for direct activity-linked emissions,
* Scope 2 for purchased energy-related indirect emissions, 
* And Scope 3 for upstream and downstream value-chain emissions.
4. Apply layered rules per row:
* NAICS prefix rules, 
* Then title keyword rules, 
* Then de-duplication while preserving insertion order.

This mapping requires expert review to refine the inital mapping procedure. 
The most robust method would be to improve on the heuristic classification. 
But idonsycratic decisions can be inserted though the logic will be left to the expert reviewer and absent from the coding structure.
